name: USD/JPY spot FX
notes: Quote currency JPY; account-currency conversion is not modelled (capital is treated as quote-currency units). No real volume. Broker terms unverified. gap_stress_pct = 1.25 x the worst overnight gap 4.0% in the cleaned usable history (floor per asset class, capped at 25 % because unadjusted contract rolls inflate the historical maximum); min_stop_pct = 25 % of the median daily range 0.73%.
